task: Port OpenWorm c302 full-network (302 neurons + 95 muscles) C. elegans simulation, as published, run in NEURON, parameters/connections extracted to CSV.
machine: backhouse (Windows PC, WSL2 Ubuntu, user greff); work confined to ~/worm-port/c302/

software_versions.owmeta: not installed (c302 proceeds without it; owmeta-cache JSON used instead for morphology placement)

parameter_set: C2 (single-compartment HH-like conductance-based cells; graded/analogue chemical synapses; electrical gap junctions; muscle-specific NMJ synapse components via custom_muscle_components.xml). Chosen because c302's own runAndPlot.py documents -fullC1 and -fullC2 as the two options for the complete network, and C2 has muscle-specific NMJ parameterisation C1 lacks.
network_config: c302_Full.py setup('C2', generate=True, duration=1000, dt=0.05, target_directory='examples', verbose=True)
connectivity_data_source: cect.readers.SpreadsheetDataReader, reading CElegansNeuronTables.xls (bundled with cect). IMPORTANT CAVEAT: cect's own READER_DESCRIPTION string for this reader states verbatim: 'legacy dataset (based on White_whole) used in the past in OpenWorm. Only included here for reference! Do not use!' This is the reader c302's default Full-network generation path actually invokes; it is NOT the Cook 2019 adjacency data (cect.Cook2019HermReader exists as an alternative reader but is not what generate() used here). Treat all connectivity counts in c302_connections.csv as coming from this legacy/flagged-as-deprecated source, not from Cook 2019.
muscle_name_list_example: MDL01-MDL24 (24), MDR01-MDR24 (24), MVL01-MVL23 (23), MVR01-MVR24 (24) = 95 total; dorsal/ventral, left/right body-wall muscle numbering, consistent with the standard WormAtlas/White et al. muscle naming scheme used throughout c302 and CeNGEN-adjacent worm literature (same root convention as Cook 2019's body-wall muscle names, e.g. Cook 2019 dBWML1..24 etc. map 1:1 in position/number to c302's MDL/MVL 01..24 by dorsal/ventral left/right position, though no explicit c302-authored lookup table confirming an exact id correspondence was found in this install -- treat the mapping as positional/by-convention, not as a verified cect/c302 crosswalk).

network_topology_counts.connection_breakdown: 1084 electrical (all neuron-neuron) + 2831 chemical (2079 excitatory neuron-neuron + 200 inhibitory neuron-neuron + 428 excitatory NMJ (neuron-muscle) + 124 inhibitory NMJ (neuron-muscle))
network_topology_counts.note: neuron_to_muscle_elec_syn and muscle_to_muscle_elec_syn gap-junction components are defined with nonzero (neuron-muscle) or zero (muscle-muscle, by design) conductance in parameters_C2.py but 0 actual connections of either kind exist in the generated network; only neuron-neuron gap junctions are instantiated.

stimulus.label_in_c302_source: c302 itself labels this bioparameter group with source 'KnownError' at the C2-default level and overrides it specifically for the Full config in c302_Full.py; the override amplitude/delay/duration above are what actually ran. Not a physiological input; c302 calls this group 'unphysiological_offset_current' in its own naming.

exact_commands_run: On the Mac side: ssh backhouse 'wsl -d Ubuntu -- bash -s' < <local script file>  (used for every remote step; nested quoting under cmd.exe breaks, so scripts were always piped via stdin)
export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH && taskset -c 0-3 uv pip install neuron==9.0.2   (installed into /home/greff/worm-tools/c302_env)

cd /home/greff/worm-port/c302 && python3 genfull.py   # wraps: from c302 import c302_Full; c302_Full.setup('C2', generate=True, duration=1000, dt=0.05, target_directory='examples', verbose=True)  -> generates examples/c302_C2_Full.net.nml, LEMS_c302_C2_Full.xml, cell_C.xml, custom_muscle_components.xml, custom_synapses.xml

cd /home/greff/worm-port/c302/examples && export NEURON_HOME=/home/greff/worm-tools/c302_env && /usr/bin/time -v taskset -c 0-3 pynml LEMS_c302_C2_Full.xml -neuron -run -nogui   # generates all .mod/.hoc files, compiles them, runs the NEURON simulation; detached via setsid nohup job_run_neuron2.sh > /dev/null 2>&1 < /dev/null & ; sleep 3

cd /home/greff/worm-port/c302/examples && python3 analyze.py   # loads c302_C2_Full.dat and c302_C2_Full.muscles.dat, computes per-cell min/max/mean V, NaN/out-of-range checks, writes voltage_stats.csv and traces.png
cd /home/greff/worm-port/c302/examples && python3 extract.py   # regex-parses c302_C2_Full.net.nml into cells_extract.csv and connections_extract2.csv

output_data_sanity_checks.qualitative_finding: No numerical blow-up or NaN anywhere across 302 neurons and 95 muscles. But with only PLML/PLMR current-injected (the Full config's built-in test stimulus), activity does not show rhythmic/oscillatory locomotor-like bursting: essentially the whole network depolarises into one broad, roughly saturating plateau rather than distinct per-cell dynamics. This is consistent with the network being correctly wired and excitable, but it is not evidence of a validated locomotor pattern -- the stimulus itself is labelled unphysiological by c302's own source.
